name: 80218 · Denver, CO
findings: ZIP 80218 (Denver) has 134 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Political organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80218 (Denver) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 80218 (Denver) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
